tagline: The FL Evolution league newsletter · est. 2019
headline: YoungBuck04 Wins by 0.26, triccster Finally Beats butterygoop, and Jbird531 Is 10-1
dek: Inside: one of the five closest games in league history, triccster's 144.32, what the night games touched and what they hold this week, position groups, who is on IR, every team's odds since week 1, the bracket if the season ended today, and YoungBuck04 against triccster.
lead:
YoungBuck04 beat TrifectaRich 119.34 to 119.08. The 0.26 margin is the fifth-closest game in league history, out of 740, and the closest week 11 game on record. TrifectaRich has now lost two of the seven closest games in league history in back-to-back weeks, 0.34 to triccster in week 10 and 0.26 here, and he also lost the closest of them all, by 0.02 to Wallner in the 2024 consolation bracket. His best lineup this week, 120.28, would have won.

triccster scored 144.32, the high score of the week, and beat butterygoop by 47.34 for his first win over him in nine meetings. Jonah Coleman scored 32.9 against Las Vegas. triccster is 8-3, second, with a 70% chance at the second bye.

Jbird531 beat thecreamer and is 10-1, the first time he has reached ten wins this early in this league.

managers.text: Beat thecreamer 92.70 to 86.58, a fourth straight win, behind Ladd McConkey (18.2), Tetairoa McMillan (16.1) and Nico Collins (13.3) on Thursday night. Rashod Bateman had 13.7 on the bench. His best start through week 11 before this was eight wins, in 2024 and 2025. He is at 100% for the playoffs and a bye in the model, with a 57% chance at the title. As of Wednesday Kenneth Walker III is out for Thursday's game with a groin injury, Bhayshul Tuten did not practice and is questionable with an ankle injury, and Brock Bowers was limited and is questionable, with his coach optimistic about Sunday night.
managers.next: Week 12: RebuildingRUs. Jbird531 leads the series 7-1 and is an 85% favorite.

managers.arc: Second, and a bye in reach
managers.text: Beat butterygoop 144.32 to 96.98 (see the lead). Coleman, Travis Kelce (22.4) and C.J. Stroud (20.46) led it; Jared Goff had 20.36 on the bench, and Deebo Samuel started for 6.2. 8-3 ties his best start through week 11, from 2021. Kyren Williams has already scored 14.5 for week 12 in Wednesday's game. On a popular fantasy show Monday (Nov 23), Coleman was the betting favorite for Offensive Rookie of the Year and the hosts called the Denver backfield his; one host also said he doesn't think Puka Nacua, who had MCL surgery that may end his season, plays another down for the Rams. By Wednesday's show, Jayden Daniels's playoff schedule, at Minnesota and at Jacksonville, had made him their likeliest letdown among three quarterbacks they compared for the fantasy playoffs. As of Wednesday Zay Flowers was limited with an ankle injury and Mike Evans did not practice with his Achilles, and both are questionable. He claimed Tommy DeVito (see the moves).
managers.next: Week 12: YoungBuck04, the game of the week. triccster is a 63% favorite; YoungBuck04 leads the series 7-6.

managers.text: Lost 144.32 to 96.98 to triccster. Jahmyr Gibbs (25.8), CeeDee Lamb (24.7) and Aaron Rodgers (15.98) led it, Jaylen Warren started for 3.9, and Jack Bech had 18.8 on the bench. It has been a season of quarterbacks for him. Lamar Jackson and Jalen Hurts are in his IR slots, Gardner Minshew is on injured reserve after season-ending surgery, and Rodgers, whom he traded for before the deadline, was benched by Pittsburgh late Tuesday and released on Wednesday. His reaction in the league chat Tuesday night: "well there goes my season." Josh Johnson is the only quarterback in his week 12 lineup. Two straight losses drop him to third, and his chance at a bye is 20%.
managers.next: Week 12: TrifectaRich. butterygoop has won eight straight in the series, leads it 9-1, and is a 58% favorite.

managers.text: Beat TrifectaRich 119.34 to 119.08 (see the lead). Dak Prescott (35.9), Chuba Hubbard (26.0) and Justin Herbert (22.44) led it, and he left 44.80 on the bench, the most of the week, with Justice Hill's 15.6 the biggest piece. DK Metcalf started for 0.7. Three straight wins; all three of his earlier 7-4 starts made the playoffs. Herbert is in his week 12 lineup and, as of Wednesday, did not practice and is questionable in the concussion protocol. Seth McGowan did not practice with a hamstring injury and is questionable, and Denver suspended J.K. Dobbins for one game.

Beat Wallner 112.02 to 74.70 behind Ashton Jeanty (25.4), Fernando Mendoza (22.88) and Breece Hall (17.5). Juwan Johnson started for 0.0 after leaving Sunday's game with a hamstring injury; as of Wednesday he did not practice and is questionable. Matthew Stafford scored 3.6 in Wednesday's game. Jeanty got a vote as a possible fantasy playoff hero on a popular show Monday (Nov 23), on the strength of Las Vegas's schedule in weeks 14 to 17. 7-4 is a first for him through week 11 here, and he is 91% for the playoffs.
managers.next: Week 12: brettmn13, a rematch of the 2023 final. TuanonStan has won the last three meetings and is a 57% favorite.

managers.arc: Two of the closest, back to back
managers.text: Lost 119.34 to 119.08 to YoungBuck04 (see the lead). Patrick Mahomes (24.96), Cam Ward (22.22) and George Kittle (16.9) led it. Geno Smith had 19.44 on the bench, Ollie Gordon scored 7.7, 4.95 under his average, and Keon Coleman 2.7. He has 31.9 in the bank for week 12 already from Wednesday's game. 68% for the playoffs.

Lost 92.70 to 86.58 to Jbird531. Javonte Williams (22.6), Derrick Henry (17.1) and Tyler Shough (14.28) led it. Kirk Cousins scored 7.4, 11.38 under his average, Ryan Flournoy 1.6, and J.J. McCarthy had 14.22 on the bench. Fourth in points and seventh in the standings, at 44% for the playoffs. As of Wednesday Henry was limited in the concussion protocol and is questionable, and Christian Watson left Wednesday's game with a concussion.
managers.next: Week 12: DMsourbeer. thecreamer has won all seven meetings and is a 64% favorite.

managers.text: Lost 98.18 to 89.92 to brettmn13. Jameson Williams (17.3), Caleb Williams (14.34) and David Montgomery (13.9) led it; Tyler Warren started for 2.7 and Antonio Williams had 16.7 on the bench. Fifth in points, eighth in the standings, 5% for the playoffs. As of Wednesday Jaxon Smith-Njigba was limited with an ankle injury and is questionable.
managers.next: Week 12: Wallner. Colt45Johnson has won the last three meetings and is a 69% favorite; Wallner leads the series 10-4.

managers.text: Beat Colt45Johnson 98.18 to 89.92 behind Emmett Johnson (22.3), Burrow (19.9) and Baker Mayfield (19.08). Rachaad White started for 0.0 and Jacory Croskey-Merritt had 14.7 on the bench. That is four wins in five weeks after an 0-6 start. With Walker out, Johnson carries Kansas City's backfield again on Thursday; the popular view on Monday (Nov 23) was that the work goes back to Walker when he returns.

Beat RebuildingRUs 85.02 to 63.70 behind Bucky Irving (17.5), James Cook III (16.2) and Bryce Young (15.96), with Ted Hurst III's 20.1 on the bench. As of Wednesday Jordan Addison did not practice with his thumb injury and is questionable.

Lost 85.02 to 63.70 to DMsourbeer. Brock Purdy (22.2), DJ Moore (19.1) and Trey McBride (10.3) led it. Drake Maye and Wan'Dale Robinson both started and scored 0.0; Maye is out at least six more weeks and Robinson for the season, and both were still in his week 12 lineup when it was read Thursday morning. As of Wednesday Purdy did not practice with an ankle injury and is questionable. 8% to finish last.

tags.t: Most points left on the bench

managers.text: Lost 112.02 to 74.70 to TuanonStan, a seventh straight loss. Parker Washington (14.3), Bo Nix (11.5) and Tony Pollard (11.0) led it, and Devaughn Vele had 11.1 on the bench. Mason Rudolph starts for Pittsburgh on Friday after the Rodgers benching. Stefon Diggs missed Wednesday's practice for personal reasons and is questionable. 92% to finish last.

moves.intro: The deadline has passed, so the moves are claims, and the biggest one was triccster's.

items.title: Tommy DeVito for $40
items.text: triccster claimed Tommy DeVito for $40, dropping Chris Brooks. DeVito is New England's quarterback with Drake Maye out at least six weeks.

items.title: Josh Johnson
items.text: butterygoop added Josh Johnson, Arizona's starter in week 11 with Carson Beck ruled out. Rodgers, the quarterback he traded for before the deadline, was released by Pittsburgh on Wednesday.
items.verdict: Quarterback depth, with Jackson and Hurts in his IR slots.

trends.title: What eleven weeks means here
trends.text: All four teams that were 10-1 after eleven weeks in this league won the title. 9-2, 8-3 and 7-4 teams made the playoffs 30 times out of 30. 6-5 teams got in 5 of 9 times, 5-6 teams 2 of 10, 4-7 teams once in 9, and none of the 22 teams at 3-8 or worse.

trends.title: Scoring
trends.text: Week 11 averaged 98.5 a team, down from 111.3 in week 10.

trends.title: The wire
trends.text: Sterling Shepard scored 15.4 while unrostered in week 11, and three losses would have gone the other way with him in: TrifectaRich's in place of Keon Coleman, thecreamer's in place of Ryan Flournoy, and Colt45Johnson's in place of Kyle McCord. Waiver timing is not checked.

history.title: Week 11, all time
history.text: The highest week 11 score is still butterygoop's 169.66 against triccster in 2021, and the biggest week 11 blowout is brettmn13 over RebuildingRUs, 128.72 to 37.66, in 2022. Until this week the closest week 11 game was butterygoop over YoungBuck04, 118.22 to 117.28, in 2024.

ahead: Game of the week: YoungBuck04 against triccster, 7-4 against 8-3, with triccster holding the second bye and both sides starting players in Thursday's Eagles and Cowboys game. Also: butterygoop against TrifectaRich, and TuanonStan against brettmn13, a rematch of the 2023 final.

features.label: Primetime
features.title: The night games, both ways
features.dek: Which matchups last week's primetime games touched and changed, and who has what riding on the holiday slate.

blocks.text: Thursday night, Indianapolis at Houston, touched five of the six matchups. Sunday night, Minnesota against San Francisco, touched all six. Monday night, Cincinnati at Washington, touched five.

Thursday night outscored the margin in one game. Nico Collins scored 13.3 for Jbird531, who beat thecreamer by 6.12, and thecreamer had nobody playing in it. Monday night did the same in brettmn13's 8.26 win over Colt45Johnson: Joe Burrow scored 19.9 for brettmn13 and Tee Higgins 11.3 for Colt45Johnson, a difference of 8.6. YoungBuck04's 0.26 win over TrifectaRich needed every point, including Seth McGowan's 1.3 on Thursday before he left with a hamstring injury and Ja'Marr Chase's 5.6 on Monday.

Sunday night was not bigger than the margin anywhere. Brock Purdy's 22.2 for RebuildingRUs was the biggest score in it, and George Kittle's 16.9 for TrifectaRich came in a game TrifectaRich lost anyway.

items: Already played, Wednesday, Green Bay at the Rams: TrifectaRich banked 31.9 from Blake Corum and Matthew Golden, triccster 14.5 from Kyren Williams, and TuanonStan 3.6 from Matthew Stafford.

Thanksgiving, Chicago at Detroit: four matchups. Colt45Johnson starts Caleb Williams, D'Andre Swift and Jameson Williams, 45.68 projected, and Wallner has nobody in it. butterygoop has Jahmyr Gibbs and Sam LaPorta, 34.04, against a TrifectaRich side with nobody.

Thanksgiving, Philadelphia at Dallas: the game of the week plays out here first. YoungBuck04 starts Dak Prescott and George Pickens, 33.06 projected, against triccster's Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith, 26.41. thecreamer has Javonte Williams and Ryan Flournoy, 24.87.
Thanksgiving night, Kansas City at Buffalo: five matchups, the most of any game. Jbird531's Josh Allen, 19.48 projected, against RebuildingRUs's DJ Moore and Josh Downs, 13.8.
Black Friday, Denver at Pittsburgh: Wallner starts both quarterbacks, Bo Nix and Mason Rudolph, 25.39 projected. triccster has Jonah Coleman at 16.36 against YoungBuck04's Pat Bryant at 6.16.
Sunday night, Las Vegas at Cleveland: TuanonStan has Deshaun Watson and Ashton Jeanty, 27.0, and brettmn13 has nobody in it.

Monday night, Carolina at Tampa Bay: DMsourbeer starts Bucky Irving, Bryce Young and Darren Waller, 40.07 projected, and thecreamer has nobody in it, so that matchup may still be open going into the last game of the week.

features.label: Position groups
features.title: What each spot has actually produced
features.dek: Two different questions. From the lineup is what a manager has banked at that position over eleven weeks from whoever he started, flex and superflex included. On paper is every point the roster as it stands today has scored this season on a roster in this league, including points scored for a previous owner.

blocks.text: butterygoop is first in the league from running back and last from quarterback, the only manager at both ends. His backs have scored 808 on paper, led by Jahmyr Gibbs at 258.7.

The widest gap between the two columns is YoungBuck04 at tight end: third on paper at 299, eleventh from the lineup at 47. Mike Gesicki has 82.3 this season and 1.4 of it came in YoungBuck04's lineup. Jbird531's tight ends lead on paper at 331 and have given him 131, with Brock Bowers at 124.8 on paper and 102.2 started.

RebuildingRUs is second from quarterback and last from running back, 58.6 behind eleventh. TuanonStan is the other split: third in quarterback points on paper at 617, sixth from the lineup at 321 and none of Deshaun Watson's 139.3 has come in his lineup.

Through week 11, from Sleeper box scores, read Thursday morning. From the lineup counts only players actually started that week. On paper counts every point the current roster has scored this season while rostered in this league, whoever owned the player at the time.

blocks.text: Each team has two IR slots. Six of the twelve have both filled.

items: triccster: Puka Nacua and Tank Bigsby
butterygoop: Lamar Jackson and Jalen Hurts
Wallner: James Conner and Romeo Doubs
YoungBuck04: Kendrick Bourne and Jake Tonges
Colt45Johnson: Ricky Pearsall and Tyler Huntley
DMsourbeer: Jayden Higgins and Tyjae Spears
TrifectaRich: Chris Brazzell II, with one slot open

blocks.text: TuanonStan, brettmn13, thecreamer, Jbird531 and RebuildingRUs have both slots empty. Two of them are carrying injured reserve players on the bench instead. RebuildingRUs has five: RJ Harvey, TreVeyon Henderson, Brian Robinson Jr., Tyquan Thornton and Wan'Dale Robinson, who is out for the season and was in his starting lineup in week 11. Jbird531 has four: Michael Wilson, Trey Benson, Brashard Smith and De'Zhaun Stribling.
IR slots read from the Sleeper rosters Thursday morning; injured reserve status as FantasyPros listed it the same morning.
All 32 NFL teams play in week 12, and byes are finished for the season, so no team loses anyone to a bye from here on.
